about: The words a study is shown in: the status labels, the counts' nouns and the confirm wording. This file is the framework's. SourceText consumes it verbatim (web-shared/study-words.json) and so does Jack's Corner; neither keeps a second copy.

A study names a set (study.md's word_set, 'default' when it says nothing) and a language. A set is an overlay: per language, a key here replaces the default set's string with the same key. A language a set does not have at all falls back to that set's English, then to default/en. A key missing from a language the set does have falls back to default/<language>, then to default/en, which holds every key.
Display only. Stored codes (finding statuses, exports, sync, packs, feeds) never change, and no word here is read back as data.
